title: Building Automation System (BAS) Preventive Maintenance Service Contract – U.S. Embassy Astana
agency_path: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US EMBASSY NUR-SULTAN
detail_text: The U.S. Embassy Astana, Kazakhstan requires a Building Automation System (BAS) Preventive Maintenance Services in support of U.S. Department of State facilities in Astana, Kazakhstan. Please e-mail to the primary and the secondary contact listed in this pre-solicitation if you are interested in participation. This announcement constitutes a pre‑solicitation notice only; it is not a request for quotations or proposals and does not commit the U.S. Government to award a contract.The Embassy on the United States in Astana, Kazakhstan will launch the solicitation when it is available.
